test_title: PYST 31: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. E sits second to the left of B. C sits second to the right of F. D is on the immediate left of C. Who is sitting on the immediate right of A?
solution:
A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. E sits second to the left of B.

2. C sits second to the right of F.

3. D is on the immediate left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd279c4ec64e6ec1002480b62f3821f470a5bd1c3ad97652047e74debe6e5ffb.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9eaf9c47ca947a61146aba74ec9896938418eefb51f7582a900b597e38c157b.png] 

B sitting on the immediate right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.
